_comment: Copy to config.json (or specify path via ARTEX_CONFIG env var). This file only configures database and skill_dir; LLM and remaining settings use env vars or in-app settings.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Precedence: ARTEX_PG_DSN env var > this file. Choose one format: (A) discrete fields below; (B) single database.dsn connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Format (B): Replace discrete fields with a full DSN. A non-empty dsn overrides discrete fields.
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root directory (one subdirectory per skill containing SKILL.md). Precedence: ARTEX_SKILL_DIR env var > this field > default (skills/ adjacent to binary). Leave empty or remove to use default. Relative paths resolve against working directory.
